name: Ingredion
outlook:
What Ingredion says to expect

  • Full year 2026: diluted EPSThe Company now expects its full-year 2026 reported diluted EPS to be in the range of $8.04 to $8.49, and its adjusted diluted EPS to be in the range of $9.25 to $9.70.
  • Full year 2026: net salesThe Company now expects full-year 2026 net sales to be flat, reflecting volume growth and favorable foreign exchange, offset by lower price mix as well as the impact of the previously mentioned sale of its majority stake in the Pakistan business.
  • Full year 2026: cash from operationsCash from operations for the full year 2026 is now expected to be in the range of $650 million to $750 million. Capital expenditures for the full year are still expected to be approximately $450 to $490 million.
  • Full year 2026: effective tax rateFor full-year 2026, the Company expects a reported effective tax rate of 27.9% to 28.9% and expects an adjusted effective tax rate of 26.5% to 27.5%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
